sources.entry: Bagisto - Leading Laravel open source e-commerce framework with multi-inventory sources, taxation, localization, dropshipping and more exciting features. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Bagisto is an open-source Laravel and Vue.js eCommerce platform that supports single-vendor stores, multi-vendor marketplaces and B2B commerce.
summary.what_it_does: Bagisto is a PHP/Laravel framework for building online stores and marketplaces, with Vue.js used on the front end. The README describes features including multi-inventory sources, taxation, localization and dropshipping (per the listing), plus a B2B module for company-based purchasing, quotes and procurement. A multi-vendor marketplace module lets an admin manage sellers, commissions and product approvals while vendors get their own dashboard. The README also mentions a multi-tenant SaaS option, a POS, headless storefronts with Next.js, a Flutter mobile app, and LLM integrations. It can be installed with or without Composer, and Docker images are published with Nginx, Apache or OpenLiteSpeed web servers and MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL databases. The README links to a 200+ extension marketplace.
use_cases: point of sale and inventory management
build a mobile shopping app with Flutter
how_to_run: Install with Composer or without it (see the Installation Guide in the docs)
Pin a specific release tag, e.g. webkul/bagisto:2.5.0-nginx-postgres
notable: Docker image ships fully installed with migrations, seed data and search indexes, so no first-run setup is needed
Matrix of prebuilt Docker tags covering Nginx, Apache or OpenLiteSpeed with MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL
Built-in multi-vendor marketplace with seller management, commissions and product approvals
Headless commerce option with a Next.js storefront and a Flutter mobile app
caveats: Several advanced features (B2B, multi-vendor, POS, cloud hosting, AWS AMI) are described as separate products or offerings, and the README does not state their pricing or licensing
The README does not list system requirements; it refers to a separate Requirement Details page
Blockchain and AI sections describe general integration possibilities, not built-in functionality
